cast: Japanese metalworking factory with CNC machines, concrete floor and bright lighting. Workers wear light-gray zip-up work jackets, matching trousers and safety glasses; a veteran man in his 50s and a young man in his 20s. Office staff wear navy jackets.

assignments.scene: A worker in a gray work jacket loads a metal part into a running CNC machine while a colleague watches nearby.
Wide view of a metal machining line with several CNC machines running and workers tending them along the aisle.
Close-up of a worker's gloved hands adjusting the settings and fixture on a machine.
Defective metal parts lined up on an inspection table while a worker's hands examine one.
A veteran foreman in a gray work jacket writes a production schedule by hand on paper at a desk in the factory.
Warehouse shelves piled high with raw metal materials and boxes, a worker walking past.
Vertical view of an aisle between running machine tools, with a worker walking along it checking the machines.
An office desk with a fax machine and a telephone, a staff member in a navy jacket reading a received sheet.
A worker in a gray jacket checks machine status on a tablet beside a running machine, a colleague next to him.
Close-up of a small sensor mounted on a machining machine, with a worker's hand adjusting it.
A worker in a gray jacket operates a handheld terminal in front of a machine.
A veteran worker shows a young worker how to operate a machine, pointing at the controls while the young man watches.
